dedupe_keys.name: iceland road traffic accident register map layer samgongustofa slysaskra and drone restriction zones

description: The Icelandic Transport Authority (Samgöngustofa) publishes its road traffic accident register as a map layer on the shared national GeoServer. Contents: 126,596 geolocated accidents on 29 September 2026, each with date, time, place name, year, accident type and type group, and injury severity code; the same workspace carries drone restriction zones around airports and other sensitive sites as geometry and JSON. Producer: Samgöngustofa, from police accident reports. Coverage: Iceland, with records spanning many years (the sample record dates from 2013). Format and access: WFS and WMS services at gis.is (GML, GeoJSON, shapefile, CSV output) that can be queried by year or type; Samgöngustofa also publishes yearly accident statistics on its website. Free; no licence is stated on the service. Caveats: codes for accident type and severity need the authority's code list, locations are approximate for older records, and minor property-damage crashes are under-reported. Simulation uses: road safety and hotspot analysis, calibration of accident risk in network models, and studies of weather-related crashes on exposed Icelandic roads; the drone zones inform UAV use for infrastructure inspection. Related records: Vegagerðin road and traffic data services (data-vegagerdin-road-data-services) and the IS 50V road network (data-iceland-is50v-topographic-database).
